answer: Require every agent identity to lock a small stake that is slashed on proven fraud, then pass reputation through a prism of independent attestations: only peers with their own stake at risk can vouch for a newcomer, and their endorsement weight scales with their stake and history. A fresh identity begins at the dawn of its reputation with zero weight, so minting a thousand fakes demands a thousand locked stakes — no ivory-tower committee needed, just capital at risk and peer proof.
